name: Williamson County Schools
seoDescription: Find WCS 2026–27 and 2027–28 dates, grade-specific opening schedules, breaks, half days, early release, late starts and official calendar PDFs.
districtFact: WCS does not use one identical daily schedule for every grade. Its 2026–27 calendar opens in three stages, assigns 113-minute early releases to elementary schools and Hillsboro School, and schedules 45-minute late starts for grades 6–12 outside Hillsboro's middle grades.

about.title: The first student date is not the first full day for every grade
about.content: In 2026–27, students in grades 1–12 begin with a half day, return for a full day the next morning, and kindergarten, Pre-K and Early Childhood begin later. The calendar page keeps those milestones separate so the first-day answer does not erase the grade-level schedule.

about.title: Early release and late start follow different grade bands
about.content: WCS publishes 113-minute early releases for elementary schools and Hillsboro School and 45-minute late starts for grades 6–12. Hillsboro's grades 6–8 follow the early-release schedule rather than the secondary late-start schedule.

about.title: WCS calendar labels describe different operating conditions
about.content: The district distinguishes No Students, No School and System Closed. Those labels tell families whether teachers or 12-month employees may still be working even when students do not report.

about.title: The weather plan uses stockpiled instructional time
about.content: The 2026–27 student calendar says WCS can absorb up to 10 inclement-weather days without a makeup. It also prints the order of dates the district recommends using if more than 10 days are missed; none of those dates should be treated as a makeup day unless WCS activates it.

calendarNotes: Use the Student School Calendar for districtwide attendance dates. The Staff School Calendar explains teacher activity during student-free days, while the Late Start and Early Release files control grade-specific schedule changes. Pay and Monthly Work calendars are employee resources and do not determine student attendance. A downloaded ICS file is a one-time copy and will not update after a district revision or weather decision.

planningTips.title: Planning with the WCS calendar
content: Match every late-start or early-release date to the student's grade band before changing transportation or childcare.
Treat the half-day opening for grades 1–12 and the later kindergarten, Pre-K and Early Childhood opening as separate dates.
Use the Staff School Calendar only to understand staff activity; use the Student School Calendar for student attendance.
Do not assume a printed weather-contingency date is active unless WCS announces that it will be used.
Check the student's school for exact bell times, conference appointments, activities and building-level events.
